sections.voiceover: China currently leads the refining process across 19 out of 20 strategic critical minerals. Processing facilities create global supply chokepoints. Where is the Baotou basin located?

sections.voiceover: Deng Xiaoping declared during his 1992 Southern Tour that China has rare earths just as the Middle East has oil.

sections.voiceover: The Center for Strategic and International Studies reported that reducing reliance on Chinese processing capacity is the primary strategic objective for the United States.
